title: Galloping Rider with Flag
coreRelationships: The rider and horse form a dynamic, forward-moving silhouette against the dark background.
The American flag and the rider's hair create a strong diagonal line of motion from upper right to lower left.
The white horse and rider's light-colored costume stand out sharply against the deep black background.
The rider's gaze is directed forward, aligning with the direction of movement.
